import type { NodeDefinition, NodeExecutionContext } from 'cascade/contracts';
import { renderTarget, writeTexture } from 'cascade/gpu';

export const definition = {
  apiVersion: 1, runsOn: 'portable', capabilities: ['gpu', 'assets'],
  props: { red: { type: 'float', default: 0.5, expression: '$F / 4' } },
  outputs: { image: { kind: 'data', type: 'image' } },
} as const satisfies NodeDefinition;

export async function execute(context: NodeExecutionContext<typeof definition>) {
  const gpu = context.capabilities.gpu;
  const target = renderTarget(context, 65, 3);
  const encoder = gpu.device.createCommandEncoder();
  const pass = encoder.beginRenderPass({ colorAttachments: [{ view: target.createView(),
    clearValue: { r: context.props.red, g: 0.5, b: 0, a: 1 }, loadOp: 'clear', storeOp: 'store' }] });
  pass.end();
  gpu.device.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
  context.outputs.image.set(await writeTexture(context, target));
}
